claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for launch is policy-compliant and evidentially supported despite a known model-card weakness in credit underwriting support, because aggregate readiness passed, rehearsal had no severity-one incidents, and rollout monitoring/rollback controls will be in place.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the material weakness is resolved, the affected use case is excluded, or reviewed risk acceptance exists; otherwise disclosure duties remain.
Aggregate readiness above threshold and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness but do not alone satisfy the model-card disclosure policy.
Monitoring, rollback, and a 9% rollout are supplemental controls, not substitutes for required disclosure when the affected segment remains exposed.
Because the actor relies on a conditional defense, the condition itself must be evidenced, not merely asserted.
evidence_requests: Provide the final approved model card or launch disclosure artifact showing explicit disclosure of the credit underwriting support limitation.
Provide any approval record showing reviewed risk acceptance that specifically addresses continued exposure of credit underwriting support, if such approval exists.
Provide rollout cohort documentation showing the affected use case was excluded, if the actor relies on exclusion rather than disclosure/risk acceptance.
Provide the certification/launch sign-off showing reviewers accepted the limitation under the stated policy conditions.
specific_concerns: The summary itself says the credit underwriting support segment remains exposed in the 9% rollout while being below target on adverse-action reason explanation.
The summary itself says approved risk acceptance is not completed.
The governing policy text says rollout controls and monitoring do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
No admissible evidence is provided that the required model-card disclosure was actually completed or approved before certification.
The actor's defense is conditional ('certification proceeds only with explicit model-card disclosure'), but the available evidence does not show that condition is satisfied.
unsupported_claims: That certification is compliant as executed, rather than merely potentially defensible if explicit disclosure is actually present.
That explicit model-card disclosure of the known limitation is included in final launch materials.
That rollout controls can close the policy gap without exclusion of the affected use case or reviewed risk acceptance.
